what_remains_unverified: public access current uptime independent audit national expansion

geographic_scope: Western Province with national replication intention
what_is_verified: pilot continuation and stated intended function
what_remains_unverified: actual public database access coverage data quality national deployment

counterevidence: Japanese Embassy reports July 2024 handover of trommels and tractors for Karadiyana pilot activities
what_remains_unverified: throughput uptime persistence and province/national outcomes

claim_tested: No public facility plans are available
counterevidence: WMA public notice provides Western Province master plan and Karadiyana waste-to-energy project downloads
what_is_verified: public plan links and institutional contact
what_remains_unverified: actual implementation current operation and national coverage

claim_tested: There is no recent nationwide waste information at all
counterevidence: World Bank What a Waste 3.0 provides recent global comparative Sri Lanka records and projections
what_is_verified: source-specific generation collection treatment disposal and projections
what_remains_unverified: facility-level current operations and local-authority comparability
verdict: does not falsify because not facility inventory

counterevidence: 2025 study reports 22 Western Province stations with running capacity and production/sales
what_remains_unverified: other provinces and current national operation
verdict: does not falsify and rejects universal failure claim

claim_tested: Installed projects always equal usable capacity
counterevidence: Auditor General finds idle/failing Meta Mizer machines expired maintenance and accumulated clinical waste
geographic_scope: Selected hospitals and national institutional audit
what_is_verified: official observed failures and unresolved recommendations

claim_tested: National facility capacity is publicly comparable
counterevidence: CEA Pollution Source Inventory redirects to login; CEA portal exposes plans/guidelines but no downloadable national operational registry
what_remains_unverified: underlying records may exist behind login
verdict: conclusion survives only in qualified form

claim_tested: Western data can represent the whole country
counterevidence: 2024 national review gives province-level collection estimates but database described is Western-only
geographic_scope: All provinces for collection context; Western for database
what_is_verified: provinces differ sharply in reported generation/collection
what_remains_unverified: facility capacity data not nationally harmonized
verdict: conclusion survives for national comparability gap

claim_tested: Planned 2026 national programme proves current capacity
counterevidence: Pivithuru Purawara announced 2026-2029 with reported LKR 30bn allocation
what_remains_unverified: delivered assets operating throughput and persistence
verdict: does not falsify; remains planned evidence
